lines.text: Acronyms help you remember a short list in the right order.
Take the first letter of each item. The colours of the rainbow — violet, indigo, blue, green, yellow, orange, red — become VIBGYOR.
If the letters don't make a word, make a funny sentence instead, one word for each letter.
The planets, nearest first: My Very Educated Mother Just Served Us Nachos — Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune.
Say your word or sentence a few times, and link each letter back to its item.
Now try it on a list of your own — three to eight items.
